root_cause: hash_new_from_values (src/vm.c:1163 at base) holds a raw mrb_value* into the VM value stack (regs+kidx) and dereferences it (regs[0], regs[1]) across mrb_hash_set, which reaches mrb_eql -> mrb_funcall -> mrb_stack_extend and reallocates (and under ASan frees) the value stack; envadjust updates mrb->c->ci->stack but not the local raw pointer, so the next iteration reads freed memory. Invariant: no raw pointer into the value stack may be dereferenced after an operation that can reallocate it; stack slots must be addressed by (mrb->c->ci->stack, index)
